description: MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL on two DGX Sparks using MiaAI-Lab's current SGLang kit and creator-selected CUDA 13 nightly. Restored after correcting the build verifier for SGLang's msgspec ServerArgs contract. The kit-declared 3b38d063 checkpoint, packed MXFP4 experts, EAGLE/DFLASH/off choices and multimodal path are retained. New-document memory planning bounds the shared target pool to 65,536 tokens, two 32K requests, static allocation 0.80 and a 112.54 GB per-node peak including estimated runtime overhead. Physical Spark acceptance is pending.
title: MiMo V2.6 Flash RL SGLang two Sparks (Mia)
